settings.title: Human-grade ingredients
settings.text: The label says it plainly: human-grade ingredients for daily dog health and wellness.

settings.title: One daily multivitamin
settings.text: A single multivitamin chew instead of a shelf of separate supplements.

settings.title: 90 soft chews
settings.text: Soft chews instead of pills. The feeding guide on the jar tells you how many for your dog's weight.

settings.question: How long does one jar last?
settings.answer: Each jar has 90 soft chews. How long it lasts depends on your dog's size, so check the feeding guide on the jar.

settings.question: What's in it?
settings.answer: It's a multivitamin soft chew made with human-grade ingredients. The full ingredient list is on the jar label, shown in the product photos.

settings.question: How does the subscription work?
settings.answer: Pick "Subscribe monthly" above the add to cart button. You get a new jar every month at 10% off, and you can skip or cancel from your account.

settings.question: How much is shipping?
settings.answer: Shipping is calculated at checkout based on where you live. You'll see the exact cost before you pay.

settings.question: How do I track my order?
settings.answer: We email you a tracking link as soon as your order ships.

settings.question: Can my dog take it with medication?
settings.answer: If your dog is on prescription medication or has a health condition, check with your vet before starting any supplement.

settings.question: Which pack should I get?
settings.answer: One jar is good for trying it. The 3 and 6 jar packs cost less per jar if you already know your dog likes it.

settings.question: How do I contact you?
settings.answer: Use the contact page and we'll get back to you within 3 days.
